_comment: The symptoms flow: Select symptoms → Description, severity & start time → Save, then a summary. Severity is a custom catalog component written in Dart (lib/catalog/severity_input/severity_input.dart: SeverityInput, a 1–10 scale); everything else uses built-in components and IconBadge. "{{a,b|list}}" merges the picked symptoms with the typed ones; "{{now}}" is the current local date and time. Routing and placeholders work like ../nutrition/flow.json. Step 1's Continue check reads "<number picked>|<typed text>" and passes unless it is "0|" (nothing picked or typed): genui's and/or functions don't evaluate function calls nested in their list, so one regex check stands in for "picked OR typed".
